description:
As a customer, I want to search so I can find a tool quickly.

* A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
* A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
* Search is case-insensitive.
* Clearing the search restores the full product list.

Search matches product names (partial, case-insensitive)

criteria.text: A search term matching existing products → only matching products are listed.
A term with no matches → an empty state message, no error.
Clearing the search restores the full product list.

cases.title: Search term matching existing products lists only matching products
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <several products, at least one of which matches the search term and at least one of which does not>.
steps: Open the product list and note the full set of products shown.
Enter <a term contained in the name of at least one product, but not all> in the search field.
cases.expected: Only the products whose names match the search term are listed; the non-matching products are not shown.

cases.title: Search term with no matches shows an empty state message and no error
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <at least one product>.
steps: Enter <a term that matches no product name> in the search field.
cases.expected: An empty state message is shown (exact wording not specified in the story). No products are listed and no error is shown.

cases.title: Search is case-insensitive
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <at least one product whose name matches the chosen term>.
steps: Search for <a product name term in lower case> and note the results.
Clear the search field and search for the same term in UPPER CASE; note the results.
Clear the search field and search for the same term in MiXeD case; note the results.
cases.expected: All three searches return the same matching products.

cases.title: Clearing the search restores the full product list
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <several products, at least one of which does not match the search term used>.
steps: Open the product list and note the full set of products shown.
Enter <a term matching some but not all products> in the search field and run the search, so the list is filtered.
cases.expected: The full product list is shown again, matching the list noted in step 1.

cases.title: Partial product name fragment returns the product
cases.preconditions: The product list contains <a product whose name has more than one word or several characters>.
steps: Open the product list and note the exact name of the chosen product.
Enter only a fragment of that product name (not the whole name, for example the middle characters) in the search field.
cases.expected: The chosen product is listed; the search matches on a partial product name.
